title: Mini Glossier You Perfume Wardrobe Gift Set

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Perfume Gift Sets > Value & Gift Sets > Fragrance

descriptionHtml:
Description: This limited-edition mini kit features Glossier’s most beloved fragrance collection of skin-scent enhancers, each in perfectly sized bottles to elevate every moment. Whether you're indulging yourself or gifting someone special, it’s the perfect introduction to fragrances designed to allow you to shine through.

About the Bottle: The bottle is an objet d’art in its own right. It is crafted in-house at Glossier, it has the real thumbprint indent of the designer. So just like the scent, the bottle of Glossier You is unfinished. It needs you hold it, to complete it.

About the Fragrance: The addictive Glossier You Collection is made up of personal skin-scent enhancers, with base notes that let more of you shine thro
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Minis don’t have spritzers—beware of spills.
-Use the cap: Keep the cap on. Flip the mini upside down to wet the cap. Flip the mini right side up, remove cap. Tap the cap to the pulse points.
-Use your skin: Remove the cap. Place the opening of the bottle flush against fingertip or pulse point (wrist). Quickly flip it upside down, then right side up to release a drop.
Ingredients+
Glossier You:
Alcohol Denat., Fragrance/Parfum, Water/Aqua/Eau, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Hexamethylindanopyran, Hydroxycitronellal, Linalyl Acetate, Hexadecanolactone, Farnesol, Pinene, Limonene, Rose Ketones, Beta-Caryophyllene.

Glossier You Doux:
Alcohol Denat., Fragrance/Parfum, Water/Aqua/Eau, Hydroxycitronellal, Eugenol, Limonene.

Glossier You Fleur:
Alcohol Denat., Water/Aqua/Eau, Fragrance/Parfum, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Hexamethylindanopyran, Benzyl Salicylate, Juniperus Virginiana Oil, Cananga Odorata Oil/Extract, Santalum Album Oil, Linalyl Acetate, Linalool, Hydroxycitronellal, Coumarin, Vanillin, Geraniol, Hexadecanolactone, Geranyl Acetate, Santalol, Beta-Caryophyllene, Pinene, Limonene, Rose Ketones.

Glossier You Soie:
Alcohol Denat., Fragrance/Parfum, Water/Aqua/Eau, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Hexamethylindanopyran, Pelargonium Graveolens Flower Oil, Santalum Album Oil, Vanillin, Benzyl Salicylate, Trimethylcyclopentenyl Methylisopentenol, Santalol, Coumarin, Citronellol, Farnesol, Linalool, Benzaldehyde, Pinene, Limonene, Beta-Caryophyllene.
